name: Preflight
tagline: A shift-cover agent that checks before it acts.

entrypoints.cli: python -m app "Ward 4B needs night cover tomorrow"

sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true runs the full demo with no credentials (DuckDB over synthetic CSVs, rule-based generator)

zetaris.role: Federates the three source systems (CSV file source, Postgres leave system, REST skills service); every fact and precondition check is read-only SQL over its direct REST API, with cross-source joins in single statements

nvidia.role: The single injected generator: parses the request, ranks candidate staff from World Model facts and H-MEM memories, and writes the investigation when nothing passes. It never decides whether an action fires; the SQL checks do.

evaluation.method: 200 random synthetic worlds x 6 requests; every action re-checked by an independent oracle (evals/oracle.py)
